## Asana Announces New AI Teammates: Collaborative Agents That Deliver Results
25, 2025-- [Asana, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fasana.com%2F&esheet=54329422&newsitemid=20250925695672&lan=en-US&anchor=Asana%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=01462264de8ebb47c53ad6036ad3839f) (NYSE: ASAN), a leading work management platform for human + AI collaboration, today announced [AI Teammates](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fasana.com%2Fproduct%2Fai%2Fai-teammates&esheet=54329422&newsitemid=20250925695672&lan=en-US&anchor=AI+Teammates&index=2&md5=94211f9dea2e5c9d78fae46c4faf2e30): collaborative agents that understand the context of all work across an organization and how that work gets done.

AI Teammates extend Asana’s existing AI capabilities, which include [AI Studio](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fasana.com%2Fproduct%2Fai%2Fai-studio&esheet=54329422&newsitemid=20250925695672&lan=en-US&anchor=AI+Studio&index=3&md5=96c66897ed3e0619e504798ca2d1e2c0), a no-code builder for AI-powered workflows that handle repeatable, routine tasks at high volume.

Unlike other agents that work separately from team workflows, AI Teammates operate within Asana’s work management platform, which guarantees transparency and accountability.

We’re excited to be the platform that makes this all possible.”

[Asana](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.asana.com&esheet=54329422&newsitemid=20250925695672&lan=en-US&anchor=Asana&index=4&md5=83293ea108b82817b8ed97a39da719f9) is a leading work management platform for human + AI collaboration.

web.description:
# Platform & Features
[**Knowledge Base Management** \
\
Upload files, crawl websites, and manage the knowledge your AI teammates use to answer questions accurately.\
\
4min read](https://teammates.ai/help/platform/knowledge-base-management) [**Workflows** \
\
Automate multi-step processes with workflows. Define triggers, conditions, and actions to streamline your operations.\
\
4min read](https://teammates.ai/help/platform/workflows) [**Actions** \
\
Give your AI teammates the ability to look up orders, create tickets, check inventory, and more through connected actions.\
\
3min read](https://teammates.ai/help/platform/actions) [**Analytics & Insights** \
\
Track performance across all your AI teammates with conversation metrics, resolution rates, and actionable insights.\
\
3min read](https://teammates.ai/help/platform/analytics-insights) [**Conversations & Inbox** \
\
View, search, and manage all customer conversations across channels in one unified inbox.\
\
3min read](https://teammates.ai/help/platform/conversations-inbox) [**Workspace** \
\
Your central hub for activity, knowledge gaps, constitution, CRM data, and cross-teammate insights.\
\
3min read](https://teammates.ai/help/platform/workspace) [**Account & Organization Settings** \
\
Manage your profile, team members, organization settings, and general AI teammate configuration.\
\
3min read](https://teammates.ai/help/platform/account-organization-settings) [**Tickets** \
\
Track, manage, and resolve support tickets created by your AI teammates or synced from your help desk.\
\
3min read](https://teammates.ai/help/platform/tickets) [**Human Agent Handoff** \
\
Learn how to configure and manage seamless handoffs from AI teammates to your human support team.\
\
4min read](https://teammates.ai/help/platform/human-agent-handoff) [**Autonomy Policies** \
\
Control how independently your AI teammates operate — from fully autonomous to human-approved drafts.\
\
3min read](https://teammates.ai/help/platform/autonomy-policies)
